rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the tall grass-like plant growing near water.

example.english: The clump of reed by the river was blown every which way.
example.traditional: 河邊嗰堆蘆葦畀風吹到東歪西倒。
example.jyutping: ho4 bin1 go2 deoi1 lou4 wai5 bei2 fung1 ceoi1 dou2 dung1 waai1 sai1 dou2

rows.note: Use this for the thin vibrating part inside a clarinet, saxophone, harmonica, or similar instrument.

example.english: The reed in my saxophone has split, so I need to replace it.
example.traditional: 我支色士風嘅簧片裂咗，要換喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zi1 sik1 si6 fung1 ge3 wong4 pin3 lit6 zo2 jiu3 wun6 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the hollow stem of the plant, rather than the whole plant or a musical-instrument reed.

example.english: A reed stem is usually hollow and can be used to make a simple instrument.
example.traditional: 蘆葦莖通常係中空嘅，可用於製作簡單樂器。
example.jyutping: lou4 wai5 ging3 tung1 soeng4 hai6 zung1 hung1 ge3 ho2 jung6 jyu1 zai3 zok3 gaan2 daan1 ngok6 hei3
